Scope of Work  Sealed Design Battery (VRLA) Battery Inspection: (Per IEEE Std. #1188) All inspections shall be made under normal float conditions if possible. All measurements & observations shall be recorded for future comparisons. Annual / Semi-annual Inspection: 1). Measure and record Overall Float Voltage, most Pos. /Neg. terminals. 2). Measure and record 100% cell/jar Float Voltage readings. 3). Measure and record 100% cell/jar Internal Resistance and Connection Resistance if battery post design allows. 4). Measure and record AC ripple current & voltage, and DC charge current imposed on the battery. 5). Ambient temperature and the condition of ventilation and monitoring equipment. 6). Visually inspect individual cell/jar condition, checks to include: a). Cell/unit integrity for evidence of corrosion at terminals, connections, racks, or cabinets. b). General appearance and cleanliness of battery, racks, cabinets and battery area. c). Cover integrity, checking for cracks or leaking of electrolyte. d). Excessive jar/cover distortions. 7). Measure 10% temperature at Negative terminal. 8). Provide final report, with any recommendations and actions taken (if any).  Sure Power, Inc. Scope of Work NiCads  Battery Inspection: (Per IEEE STD. 1106-2015) All inspections shall be made under normal float conditions if possible. All measurements & observations shall be recorded for future comparisons. Annual / Quarterly-Semi-annual Inspections: 1). Measure and record Overall Float Voltage, most Pos. /Neg. terminals. 2). Measure and record AC ripple current & voltage, and DC charge current imposed on the battery. 5). Ambient temperature and the condition of ventilation and monitoring equipment. 6). Visually inspect individual cell/jar condition, checks to include: a). Cell/unit integrity for evidence of corrosion at terminals, connections, racks, or cabinets. b). General appearance and cleanliness of battery, racks, cabinets and battery area. c). Cover integrity, checking for cracks or leaking of electrolyte. d). Excessive jar/cover distortions. 7). Measure 10% temperature at Negative terminal. 8). Add distilled (deionized) water to cells as needed. 9). Provide final report, with any recommendations and actions taken (if any). Annual Notes: 1. Take 100% inter-cell connection resistance if battery design allows. 2. Battery hardware re torque is required during annual inspection if the micro-ohm  readings indicate a high resistance connection. 3. Cleaning is to be done during annual inspection. Please note that if battery has been neglected it may need to be taken offline to perform cleaning. NOTE; Battery hardware re torque is also required during annual inspection if battery string can be removed from service at time of inspection and if the micro-ohm readings indicate a high resistance connection. THIS WILL HOUSE MASTER CONTROL REDUNDANT PLCS AND SCADA SERVERS FOR EACH DATA HALL MANAGED NETWORK SWITCHES, IO MODULES, TOUCHSCREENS, AND MISC CONTROL COMPONENTS AS REQUIRED TO SUPPORT A FULLY OPERATIONAL CONTROL SYSTEM THROUGHOUT THE SITE THE SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE ALLOWS FOR EACH DATA HALL TO OPERATE IT'S OWN GENERATORS AND SWITCHGEAR IN A HOT SWAPPABLE REDUNDANT PROCESSOR SETUP WITH REMOTE IO ESTABLISHED ON A RING NETWORK. EACH DATA HALL WILL HAVE IT'S OWN ISOLATED RING NETWORK TO SUPPORT THE CRITICAL OPERATIONS WITH REDUNDANT PROCESSORS ALL DATA HALL PROCESSORS WILL THEN BE RING NETWORKED TOGETHER TO PROVIDE COMPLETE MONITORING AND CONTROL OF THE SYSTEM FROM ANY POINT IN THE OVERALL NETWORK. THE INTENT OF THIS IS TO PROVIDE A CENTRAL OPERATING STATION AT THE NOC IN THE FORM OF A REMOTE DESKTOP. THE REMOTE DESKTOP WILL HAVE ACCESS TO MONITORING AND CONTROL OF THE SITE WITH ACCESS RESTRICTIONS THE PLC NETWORK IS SEGREGATED FROM THE SCADA/HMI NETWORK. THE HMI NETWORK INCLUDES REDUNDANT SCADA & DATABASE SERVERS WITH A FIBER RING NETWORK SERVING THE SITE VIA MANAGED NETWORK SWITCHES. THE SERVERS WILL BE HOUSED IN ADMIN AND MECH POWER SYSTEMS CONTROL CABINETS. CTP-03 INCLUDES THE ADDITION OF MANAGED NETWORK SWITCHES WITH (2) SETS OF SFP FIBER SLOTS AND (18) ETHERNET PORTS IN EVERY SWITCHBOARD TO EXPAND THE CAPABILITY OF AUTOMATION AND EPMS SEGREGATION/INTEGRATION THE CP-X0Y SWITCHBOARDS ALSO NOW INCLUDE EMBEDDED IO FOR REMOTE CONTROL AND MONITORING VIA THE PLC NETWORK VERSUS ONLY MODBUS COMMS TO THE TRIP UNITS IN CTP-02. IEC 61850 GOOSE MODULES IN EACH PSC WILL BE PROGRAMMED FOR SEQUENCE OF EVENT RECORDING OF ALL BREAKER AND SYSTEM STATUS CHANGES TO THE EPMS. THE RELATIVE FILES WILL BE PREPARED FOR EPMS INTEGRATION. CRITICAL BLOCKS EACH CRITICAL BLOCK HAS 4 PRIMARY GENS A RESERVE GENERATOR IS SHARED FOR DH1&2, DH4&5. DH3 HAS IT'S OWN RESERVE GENERATOR. IN ADDITION, DH1&2, DH4&5 SHARE A LOAD BANK/ROLL-UP GENERATOR DOCKING STATION. DH3 HAS ITS OWN LOAD BANK/ROLL-UP GENERATOR DOCKING STATION. THE SITE HAS 5 TOTAL CRITICAL BLOCKS (A TOTAL OF 40 AUTOMATIC TRANSFER CONTROL SYSTEMS IN A 1G1U CONFIGURATION IN OPEN TRANSITION WITH 3 AVAILABLE SWING GENS) MECHANICAL BLOCK THERE IS 1 MECHANICAL BLOCK CONTAINING 5 GENERATORS. THERE IS NO RESERVE SWING GENERATOR, HOWEVER THE GEN-CH BOARDS ARE ALL LOOPED TOGETHER ALLOWING THE GENERATORS TO BACK UP EACH OTHER. PWRQ WILL DETERMINE THE APPROPRIATE AUTOMATIC OR MANUAL SEQUENCING OF THE SYSTEM DURING THE ENGINEERING PHASE WITH RELATIVE DECISION MAKERS. THE MECH BLOCKS ALSO NOW INCLUDE FLYWHEEL UPS SYSTEMS. DATA FROM THE UPSS WILL BE BROUGHT INTO THE HMI FOR ALARMS/INDICATIONS/RETRANSFER UPS BYPASS OPERATING MODES. -WRAP-AROUND BYPASS MODES -UPS ON BYPASS (PREVENT OPEN TRANSITION TRANSFERS) EACH BLOCK RECEIVES A REDUNDANT PLC MASTER CONTROL SYSTEM FOR THE FOLLOWING OPERATING MODES: -SWING GEN -LOAD BANK TEST -ROLL-UP GEN -UPS BYPASS TRANSFER THE POWER SYSTEM CONTROLLER (PSC) WILL CONSIST OF A REDUNDANT PLC AND HMI CENTRALLY LOCATED IN A FREESTANDING MASTER CONTROL PANEL WITHIN IT'S RESPECTIVE BLOCK'S DATA HALL ALL PSCSS WILL BE NETWORKED BACK TO A REMOTE DESKTOP LOCATED AT THE NOC THE REMOTE DESKTOP WILL ALLOW REMOTE MONITORING AND CONTROL OF EACH BLOCK FROM A CENTRALIZED LOCATION  HOUSE SWBD H3 WILL BE INTEGRATED INTO PSC-ADMIN
